label: Ticker
purpose: Minimal news ticker: white type on the ink ground, a mono wire line, thin rules and small framed pictures, with blueprint blue for the lead tick of every rule and the statement ground. For one fact, fast news and low-resolution or missing pictures.

background.source: --text-primary in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, used here as the ground: the ink the dark logotype is approved on.

surface.source: --surface-subtle in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, used here for body copy and sources on ink so the white headline stays the brightest thing on the slide.

surface-strong.source: --text-secondary in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, used here for the hairline rules and picture frames on ink.

foreground.source: --surface-reading in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, used here as the type colour on ink and on blue.

muted.source: The one supporting colour: a grey between --text-secondary and white that labels, credits and folios need on ink, where #3c4149 reads at under 2:1. It clears 5.7:1 on #14161a.

accent.source: Blueprint blue: --accent-primary and the DNESK colour of the logotype; the rules' lead tick and the statement ground.

secondary.source: The Ai colour of the logotype (brandAi in lib/og-theme.ts); the hairlines on the blue statement ground.

headline.source: A compact grotesque for headlines and copy: tight at display sizes and plain at body sizes, so one family carries the fact.

body.source: The headline's family at its regular weight: the ticker's copy reads as one voice, not as an article.

mono.source: The wire face: kickers, sources, credits and folios set like a terminal line, distinct from the editorial look's IBM Plex Mono.
